title: Reader fallback chain
finding: Validates the tiered fallback chain pdf-inspector → liteparse → pypdf against a script-local mirror of the historical pypdf-only guard (928f030) on 5 docs (2 IA GlyphLessFont scans, 1 WinAnsi, Kerr control, healthy control). liteparse tier rescues all 3 silent-empty docs; median-of-3 retries 0.05–0.20 s vs pypdf 0.31–11.5 s (~56× on the 136-page scan), omits textless pages (121/136), preserves every routing decision, never fires on healthy files. Second pdf-inspector failure mechanism recorded (IA GlyphLessFont). Evidence for ADR-066; shipped
